points.title: 早年贫苦与出家
points.description: 出身贫寒农家，少年时父母兄长相继死于饥疫，曾入皇觉寺为僧，后云游淮西。元末社会动荡中，他于1352年投奔濠州红巾军郭子兴部，开始军旅生涯。
points.descriptionEn: Born into a poor peasant family, he lost his parents and elder brothers to famine and epidemic in his youth. He entered the Huangjue Temple as a monk and later wandered in western Huai region. Amid late Yuan social turmoil, he joined Guo Zixing's Red Turban forces at Haozhou in 1352, beginning his military career.

points.title: 割据江南与统一战争
points.titleEn: Regional power in Jiangnan and wars of unification
points.description: 逐步独立发展，以应天为基地，先后击败陈友谅、张士诚等割据势力，并北伐元朝。1368年在应天称帝，国号大明，年号洪武，同年明军攻占大都，元朝在全国的统治结束。
points.descriptionEn: He gradually built an independent power based at Yingtian, defeated rival regional regimes such as Chen Youliang and Zhang Shicheng, and launched a northern expedition against the Yuan. In 1368 he proclaimed himself emperor at Yingtian, founding the Ming dynasty with the era name Hongwu; that same year Ming forces took Dadu, ending Yuan rule over China proper.

points.title: 洪武之治与制度重建
points.description: 在位期间废除中书省和丞相制，强化皇权；推行屯田、兴修水利、清丈土地与编造黄册，恢复社会经济；同时以严刑峻法整顿吏治，屡兴大狱。1398年病逝于南京，葬于孝陵。
points.descriptionEn: During his reign he abolished the Central Secretariat and the chancellorship, strengthening imperial authority; promoted military-agricultural colonies, water conservancy, land surveys and the yellow registers to restore the economy; and used harsh laws to discipline officials, launching several major purges. He died in Nanjing in 1398 and was buried at the Xiaoling mausoleum.

appraisal.zh: 朱元璋是元末明初关键的政治军事人物，结束战乱、重建统一王朝，恢复农业生产与社会秩序，奠定明代制度框架，其勤政与反腐对明初稳定起过积极作用。但通行史学同样强调，他的统治以严刑峻法和大规模政治清洗为特征，屡兴大狱、株连甚广，并强化专制皇权，对官僚士人形成高压，是明初政治紧张的重要来源；制度建构与社会控制在他身上并存，评价因视角而异。
appraisal.en: Zhu Yuanzhang is a pivotal political and military figure of the late Yuan and early Ming: he ended the wars, reunified China, restored agriculture and social order, and laid the institutional framework of the Ming, his diligence and anti-corruption efforts aiding early stability. Mainstream historiography stresses equally that his rule relied on harsh laws and large-scale purges, with several major cases implicating many, and that he strengthened autocratic power and pressed hard on officials and literati, a major source of early Ming tension; institution-building and social control coexisted in him, and assessments vary by perspective.

supporter.zh: 肯定者认为朱元璋结束元末战乱、重建统一王朝，恢复农业生产与社会秩序，奠定明代制度框架，其勤政与反腐举措对明初稳定有积极作用。
supporter.en: Supporters credit Zhu Yuanzhang with ending the late Yuan wars, reunifying China, restoring agriculture and social order, and establishing the institutional framework of the Ming dynasty; his diligence in governance and anti-corruption measures contributed to early Ming stability.

critic.zh: 批评者指出其统治以严刑峻法和大规模政治清洗为特征，屡兴大狱、株连甚广，并强化专制皇权，对官僚士人形成高压，这些做法在通行史学中被视为明初政治紧张的重要来源。
critic.en: Critics point to his reliance on harsh laws and large-scale political purges, with several major cases involving wide-ranging implicated persons, as well as his strengthening of autocratic imperial power and pressure on officials and literati; mainstream historiography regards these as major sources of political tension in the early Ming.

objective.zh: 通行史学认为朱元璋是元末明初关键的政治军事人物：他完成统一、重建中央集权制度并推动经济恢复，同时以高压手段整肃官僚体系，其统治兼具制度建构与社会控制的双重特征，评价因视角不同而存在分歧。
objective.en: Mainstream historiography regards Zhu Yuanzhang as a pivotal political and military figure of the late Yuan and early Ming: he completed unification, rebuilt centralized institutions and promoted economic recovery, while disciplining the bureaucracy through coercive means. His rule combined institution-building with social control, and assessments vary according to perspective.
